title: DC-area forecast: Warming trend starts the week, sharp cooldown ends it
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Partly sunny with a breeze this afternoon as comfortable highs reach the low to mid-70s.

What’s next? It turns toasty Tuesday and Wednesday, with highs near 80 Tuesday and well into the 80s Wednesday. Cooler weather arrives Thursday, followed by a brief warmup Friday before temperatures take a big tumble over the weekend. Showers are possible at times from Wednesday night through Friday night.

Today’s daily digit — 6/10: A murky start but a winning finish as clouds clear and sunshine returns. Highs in the 70s are just right. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Monday): Partly sunny this afternoon as the remnants of Isaias move farther away. Highs range from the low to mid-70s. Winds from the north blow at 10 to 15 mph, with occasional gusts over 20 mph. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: Partly cloudy and pleasant, with lows ranging from the mid-50s in our cooler spots to the low 60s downtown. Winds become calm. Confidence: High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Tuesday): A delightful day, especially for those hoping to hang on to summer. Skies are partly to mostly sunny, with highs near 80. Winds blow from the south at 5 to 10 mph. Confidence: High 😎 Nice Day!

Tomorrow night: Clear and rather warm for the time of year, with lows ranging from near 60 in our cooler spots to the upper 60s downtown. Confidence: High

❤️ How to support Capital Weather

Help sustain an independent Capital Weather by becoming a free or paid supporter. Learn more at capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Wednesday is partly sunny and unseasonably warm, with highs in the low to mid-80s. It's also unusually humid for October, with dew points near 70. There's a slight chance of showers Wednesday night as cooler air begins to trickle in and lows settle between 60 and 65. Confidence: Medium-High

Highs reach only around 70 on Thursday as a cool front stalls nearby, potentially bringing showers at times. A quick push of warmer air follows Friday, lifting highs well into the 70s. Showers and thunderstorms become likely by late Friday as a strong cold front moves through. It then turns windy and much colder Friday night, with temperatures dropping into the 40s. Confidence: Medium

The coolest air of the season arrives for the weekend. Despite sunshine, blustery highs reach only the mid-50s to near 60 on Saturday. Winds ease Saturday night, when lows dip into the 30s to near 40 and patchy frost could develop by early Sunday. Sunday stays sunny but chilly, with highs only in the low to mid-50s. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for October 12

A powerful 1846 hurricane drove a massive storm surge up the Potomac causing widespread coastal damage, while in 1906 an unusually early cold snap brought the earliest freezing temperature on record.
